findings.evidence: has_table then drop/create is single-CLI overwrite; concurrent indexers on one LanceDB are outside Ghostreader product use.
findings.message: ghostreader/ingestion/indexer.py:106 — TOCTOU race condition. Who is hurt: concurrent indexing processes. Failure: check-then-act gap between has_table and drop_table/create_table leads to table already exists or not found exceptions.

findings.evidence: CLI intentionally SystemExit(1) with a clear --no-cache message; tests/test_compare.py asserts that exit.
findings.message: ghostreader/commands/compare.py:71 — Hard process exit. Who is hurt: automated test harnesses and CLI wrappers. Failure: raise SystemExit(1) abruptly aborts execution on --no-cache instead of raising an exception or returning a status.
